_doc: Dataset for the advertising image's scene (Seedream), docs/plan-observabilidad-langfuse.md §7, fase 6. Ten scenes of the three FICTIONAL brands of ../copy_ai/cases.json, in every format the ad image is offered in, with a fixed hook and CTA so the words on the image are the same for every model. Scene-only (AdImageMode.SCENE): no product or background photo — add `product_photo` / `background_photo` (paths relative to this directory) to a case to test the photo modes. The image itself is attached to the Langfuse trace (fictional brands only) and every item is queued in «Revisión de imagen y video» for the human scores; the code only checks the size, the cost and the time.
